blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Lawrence Mangubat and Chris Hubilla were among the highly touted collegiate recruits in 2024 after leaving Mapua following the Cardinals’ NCAA Season 100 championship. Jose Rizal University won the sweepstakes for the star duo, and coach Nani Epondulan is now starting to see the payoff of having two league champions on his roster. “Hubilla and Mangubat are only entering their second season in the NCAA… [But] I have no question about their maturity because they already have championship experiences.” Hubilla and Mangubat played supporting roles for former league MVP Clint Escamis when the Cardinals ended a 33-year title drought two […]...
